description.de: The travel collection is a bull's-eye for all travel lovers. A colorful pattern depicting a plane crossing the most popular places around the world will catch the eye of every globetrotter. Products of the travel collection include, among others, the Eiffel Tower, the Statue of Liberty, the Egyptian Pyramids, the Warsaw's Mermaid, the Sagrada Familia and others! - Durable carabineers from a Polish manufacturer,  - Carabineer sizes adapted to the width of the lead - Super-strong stitching – envelope stitching (*except for size 10 mm) - Easy to attach XXS - Width 10mm; Lenght 130cm XS - Width 15mm; Lenght 130cm S - Width 20mm; Lenght 130cm M - Width 25mm; Lenght 130cm L - Width 30mm; Lenght 130cm

description.de: EZI TRAVEL CLASSIC is a car seat organizer. Allow your child to have everything they need accessible, games, books, water bottles...Easily organize and store what you want and enjoy peace of mind on the go. Easy to install, the EZI TRAVEL CLASSIC attaches to the headrest and backrest of your front seat with its strong straps. The EZI TRAVEL CLASSIC is made from 92% recycled plastic. The organizer and protector is built to last and stand the test of time. seat organizer and protector Storage pocket with mesh Protects the back of the front seat Easy installation with adjustable straps Easy to clean Dimensions: 59.5 x 43.5cm
